name: Ethoxylated 2-propylheptanol
description: Ethoxylated 2-propylheptanol (CAS 160875-66-1 ) is a nonionic surfactant derived from a branched C10 alcohol reacted with ethylene oxide. It delivers low-foaming emulsification, wetting, and dispersing performance across industrial and consumer systems. In home care and industrial cleaning concentrates, it functions as a low-foam wetting agent and degreaser suited for spray, CIP, and hard-surface cleaning formulations. This versatile chemical ensures high efficiency in demanding environments. Textile and leather processors use it as an emulsifier and dispersant in dyeing auxiliaries, scouring baths, and finishing agents where controlled foam is critical. It provides excellent penetration and uniform distribution during processing. In coatings and adhesive systems, it improves pigment dispersion and substrate wetting without destabilizing the resin matrix. This leads to smoother applications and enhanced durability for various industrial surface treatments. Personal care formulators incorporate it as an emulsification aid and mild humectant in rinse-off and leave-on products targeting skin feel and formulation stability. It helps maintain the integrity of complex cosmetic mixtures. Ethoxylated 2-propylheptanol is supplied as a liquid, with ethoxylation degree varying across commercial grades to tune HLB value for specific application requirements. This flexibility allows for precise formulation control. Technical-grade material is the standard offering for industrial cleaning, textile, and coatings markets. These grades are optimized for high-volume manufacturing and consistent performance in heavy-duty industrial settings. Cosmetic-grade variants meeting relevant purity specifications are available for personal care applications.
